elaine: heads-up — nightly job 22 (linux-x86-serve) red. test_session_handshake_interleaving failing intermittently (3/5). failing assert in retry ordering. short stack: `AssertionError: expected order [A,B] got [B,A]`

ci-bot: nightly/job-22 failed: https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/22 · tests: test_session_handshake_interleaving (x3 failures)

rafael: noted. i saw a similar pattern yesterday on my PR. can you paste the failing test log lines?

elaine: here's the minimal snippet:
```
--- expected
+++ actual
@@
-A B
+B A
```
Also `python -m pytest tests/runtime/test_retries.py::test_session_handshake_interleaving -q` repros 1/10 locally.

maria: tagging @tom — tom did recent scheduler change. think this could be prefetch/handshake ordering. :thinking_face: 

tom: yup that was my change. quick thought: we added a non-blocking handshake that can race with session teardown. i'll try a local reproducer now.

tom: quick update — reproduced once with `--pdb`. looks like small time skew in timestamps causes backoff comparator to flip ordering. i'll add some logging of `time.time()` and thread ids.

rafael: could be test harness scheduling. try `PYTHONASYNCIODEBUG=1` and run without xdist (`pytest -n0`) to reduce noise. also try `-k handshake -vv`.

elaine: running both now, also queued a rerun in CI. if local runs fail, i'll attach full logs.

tom: i'll bisect 9f2b3a7..HEAD (that commit touched scheduler/handshake). expect ~30m. will report commit if it pins it.

ci-bot: rerun requested by @elaine — queued job 22.rerun.1 (status: queued)

maria: small coordination note — if the bisect points to my prefetch refactor, i'll open a revert+fix PR. otherwise tom will own.

elaine: sounds good. if anyone finds a minimal fix (yield, reorder, or small sleep) drop a draft PR and mark `merge-on-green`. thanks all :pray:
